'''Monsu Island''' (Japanese: '''モンス島''' ''Mons Island'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]], found between [[Lilycove City]] and [[Mossdeep City]]. It appeared in ''[[AG097|Gaining Groudon]]'' and ''[[AG098|The Scuffle of Legends]]''.

The island's steep and rocky shoreline makes it inaccessible, though aircraft can overcome this issue. Monsu Island is home to an ancient seaside temple that is accessible through a walkway of pillars and a staircase.

After they were all blasted off by {{AP|Pikachu}}'s {{t|Electric}} attack, {{TRT}} found themselves on Monsu Island, while {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} unknowingly found [[Team Magma]]'s submarine at the same location. [[Team Aqua]] and Team Magma later met on Monsu Island to exchange a war of words.

In ''The Scuffle of Legends'', [[Archie]] unleashed {{DL|Kyogre and Groudon (Ruby and Sapphire series)|Kyogre}}'s full power with the [[Red Orb]], while Pikachu, who was bonded with the [[Blue Orb]], helped control {{DL|Kyogre and Groudon (Ruby and Sapphire series)|Groudon}}. The two [[Legendary Pokémon]] clashed, and Groudon's arrival caused Monsu Island's volcano to erupt and expand the island's landmass. The pair were eventually quelled with the help of Ash, his friends, and [[Lance]]. Kyogre returned to the ocean depths while Groudon escaped into Monsu's island volcano.
